title: Opening
description: Never wonder if you'll feel welcome again.
speakerNotes: Open with presence. Let the headline breathe. Do not rush past it.

title: This Could Be Anyone
description: Introducing Zara — or whoever is listening.
speakerNotes: Pause after 'This could be anyone.' Let the audience place themselves in the story.

title: The Origin
description: Every journey begins with a question. Ours was simple.
speakerNotes: Read each line slowly. Let the logo appear in silence.

title: The Questions
description: The three questions every traveler, newcomer, and community member asks.
speakerNotes: These are the audience's own words. Read them as if asking yourself.

title: Trust Score
description: Core brand message: We know what your community experienced.
speakerNotes: This is the central philosophical distinction. Do not rush it.

title: Discover
description: Before: uncertainty. After: confidence. She found certainty.
speakerNotes: The category chips at the bottom show breadth without overwhelming.

title: Safety Map
description: Peace of mind begins before you leave home.
speakerNotes: A pause slide. Let the compass icon and the headline do the work.

title: Safety Check-In
description: She doesn't travel alone. Even when she's the only one in the room.
speakerNotes: Walk through each step of the check-in sequence slowly. The silence at the end is intentional.

title: Community
description: Community isn't built through followers. It's built through shared experiences.
speakerNotes: Build to the final line. It should land with quiet weight.

title: Belonging
description: It happens when you stop being a newcomer and start being known.
speakerNotes: Three beats: the problem, the path, the destination.

title: KinfolkAI Teaser
description: You've found the city. Now meet someone who knows it.
speakerNotes: Pure black slide. Intentional dramatic pause. Let the silence work.

title: KinfolkAI Reveal
description: Not an assistant. A cultural guide.
speakerNotes: Two lines. That is enough. Do not explain further — let the next slide demonstrate.

title: KinfolkAI Conversation
description: Placeholder — conversation written by the founder.
speakerNotes: Replace this slide with a real KinfolkAI exchange before presenting.

title: Business: People First
description: People connect with people before they connect with products.
speakerNotes: The shift from consumer to business owner. Acknowledge the room if there are business owners present.

title: The Transformation
description: The before and after of discovery for business owners.
speakerNotes: Let the contrast speak. Read across — left then right — for each row.

title: Why We Win
description: We ask technology to earn the trust of communities. That's the difference.
speakerNotes: The middle line should land with full weight. Pause before 'That's the difference.'

title: Why Now?
description: Six reasons the moment has arrived.
speakerNotes: Each contrast should feel like a tension you're about to resolve. The final line is the answer.

title: The Movement
description: Because belonging should never depend on luck.
speakerNotes: Read 'Imagine a world where...' slowly. Each line that follows is a promise.

title: The Declaration
description: We aren't just mapping places. We're mapping belonging.
speakerNotes: Warm cream slide. Rich brown typography. 'belonging' in gold. Let it sit before advancing.

title: The Affirmation
description: You belong here.
speakerNotes: Two to three seconds of silence after this lands. Then advance.

title: The Welcome
description: Welcome home.
speakerNotes: The final emotional note. Or — end on slide 20 and say 'Welcome home.' aloud. Either works.
